name: Discovery (STS-85)
about: Discovery (STS-85) (1997-039A), a crewed vehicle (OV-103), launched 1997 Aug  7. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1997 Aug  9), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KSC RW33); its coordinates are written from memory
